title: Autonomous batch/caching orchestrator: safe deploy and rollback API
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Ship API and SDK primitives to let Optimize apply batching/caching recommendations to customer config in an auditable, recoverable, and low-risk way. This ticket implements a transactional apply/rollback flow and webhook contracts so downstream operators (Console, autosuggest) can orchestrate safe deployments and automatic rollbacks when quality or infra regressions are detected. Scope includes control-plane endpoints, webhook lifecycle, idempotency tokens, and SDK helpers. Out of scope: model-level kernel selection changes and low-level runtime batching kernels (handled by runtime team tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Control-plane 'recommendation-apply' endpoint accepts a well-formed recommendation bundle and returns a stable operation id for tracking.
Apply operations are idempotent: repeated identical requests do not create duplicate commits and return the same operation id/result.
Rollback endpoint can revert a single apply operation reliably and is safe to call multiple times (idempotent rollback).
Webhook contract: final status (succeeded/failed/rolled_back) is delivered with retry semantics and deduplication headers.
SDK exposes a high-level 'safeApply' primitive that performs preflight checks, submits apply, awaits propagation, and registers rollback hooks on failure.
Telemetry: each apply/rollback emits events with token-level cost delta estimate and affected routes/models for Console audit and billing reconciliation.
E2E tests validate a failover scenario: apply -> detect quality regression -> automatic rollback -> verify config restored and telemetry emitted.
tasks: Design API contract for apply/rollback operations and operation resource model (Asha).
Implement apply endpoint with preflight validation, dry-run mode, and operation id assignment (Ethan).
Add persistent operation record with status transitions and owner metadata (database migration).
Implement rollback endpoint that replays inverse patch with safety checks and bounded retries.
Webhook publisher with at-least-once delivery, dedup headers, and backoff/retry queue.
SDK helpers: safeApply, waitForOperation, registerRollbackHandler (Go + TypeScript).
Add idempotency token header support and verify behavior in integration tests.
Instrumentation: events for apply.request, apply.result, rollback.request, rollback.result, operation.latency, cost.delta_estimate.
Write E2E tests simulating partial failure and automatic rollback flow (CI job).
Documentation: API reference, SDK examples, Console integration notes, runbook for manual rollback.
api_contract: POST /v1/optimize/apply -> body: {recommendation_bundle, dry_run:boolean, idempotency_token?:string} -> returns {operation_id, status:'queued'|'in_progress'}.
GET /v1/optimize/operations/{operation_id} -> returns operation record with history, affected_resources, cost_delta_estimate, created_at, updated_at.
Webhook: POST to customer URL with payload {operation_id, status, summary, affected_resources, cost_delta} and headers X-Optimize-Delivery-Id, X-Optimize-Retry-Count.
idempotency_design: Clients may supply an idempotency_token (UUID v4). Server stores a hash of the token with the request fingerprint (bundle signature + requester id). If a matching token+fingerprint is seen, server returns previous operation without applying again. Token expiry: 30 days for historical lookup. For anonymous requests, server generates a strong operation id and returns 409 with guidance. Rollback uses separate idempotency token namespace but follows same semantics.
webhook_contract: Delivery: at-least-once via delivery queue with exponential backoff. Payload versioned with 'v1' and includes deduplication key 'delivery_id'. Receiver is expected to respond 2xx. Retries: up to 10 attempts over 72 hours. Security: HMAC header (X-Optimize-Signature) using customer's webhook secret. Console will surface failures and provide manual redeliver.
sdk_changes: TypeScript: Add Optimize.safeApply(bundle, opts) that handles preflight, idempotency token injection, optional waitForPropagation(timeoutMs), and automatic rollback on user-provided break conditions.
Go: Provide a low-level client for operation polling and a 'safeapply' convenience wrapper similar to TS API.
Both SDKs include helpers to validate recommendation bundles locally before submit using same lightweight rules as server preflight.
telemetry_and_monitoring: Emit metrics: optimize.apply.count, optimize.apply.latency_ms, optimize.rollback.count, optimize.operation.failure_rate.
Span traces: instrument apply -> orchestration -> webhook publish for distributed tracing and latency breakdowns.
Dashboards: operation throughput, backlog, pending rollbacks, webhook failure rate, idempotency collision rate.
Cost delta events for Console cost preview and Billing reconciliation pipeline.
e2e_test_plan: CI job that runs a simulated customer with an initial config and a batching/caching recommendation bundle.
Test 1: dry_run=true -> validate server returns predicted cost delta without changing live config.
Test 2: apply with idempotency token -> repeated submits return same operation id and do not reapply.
Test 3: apply -> inject regression by flagging quality_mse increase -> automatic rollback trigger via evaluation webhook -> verify config restored.
Test 4: webhook redelivery: simulate transient webhook failures and confirm at-least-once delivery and dedup handling.
migration_and_data_model: Add 'optimize_operations' table: {operation_id PK, requester_id, bundle_hash, idempotency_token_hash, status, created_at, updated_at, metadata_json}. Add indices on bundle_hash and idempotency_token_hash. Add 'optimize_operation_events' append-only log for status transitions. Data retention policy: operation records retained 90 days with archival on request.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag the new apply endpoints under 'optimize.safe_apply_v1' (default off for orgs with >100k tokens/month).
Alpha rollout: internal + pilot customers (2 weeks) with manual monitoring and daily check-ins.
Beta rollout: opt-in for self-serve customers with Console UI toggle and enhanced telemetry (4 weeks).
GA: enable by default with migration tools for existing recommendation pipelines (post-pilot approvals).
risks_mitigations: Risk: incorrect rollback leaves partial state. Mitigation: implement two-phase commit for control-plane patches and durable operation events; include pre-apply snapshot for quick restore.
Risk: idempotency collision or token reuse. Mitigation: include bundle fingerprint in idempotency key and surface collisions in audit logs.
Risk: webhook spam or delayed deliveries. Mitigation: rate limit per-customer webhook queue, provide dead-letter view in Console and manual redeliver option.
Risk: cost misestimation. Mitigation: require conservative default cost_delta estimates and show confidence band; block auto-apply if delta > threshold unless user overrides.
